name: backend-microservices
description: 信创工业综合治理平台后端微服务集群

scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:scada" "npm run start:data" "npm run start:workflow" "npm run start:iot"
scripts.start:all:dev: concurrently "nest start api-gateway --watch" "nest start auth-service --watch" "nest start scada-service --watch" "nest start data-center --watch" "nest start workflow-service --watch" "nest start iot-bridge --watch"
scripts.build: nest build api-gateway && nest build auth-service && nest build scada-service && nest build data-center && nest build workflow-service && nest build iot-bridge
